title: End-to-End MXFP8 Reinforcement Learning on Blackwell: What Matching Buys, When It Pays Off, and How It Fails
abstract: arXiv:2610.34915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-precision arithmetic can make reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models cheaper, but RL requires the sampler and the learner to agree. Several frameworks now run FP8 on both sides. We implement end-to-end MXFP8 RL in verl (Megatron/Transformer Engine training; vLLM and SGLang rollout; dense and MoE models) and measure on B200 GPUs, with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, what this design buys, when it is faster, and how it fails. (1) Matching. For an MXFP8 learner, a sampler on the learner's grid is more consistent than a higher-precision BF16 sampler: in one engine at fixed weights, train-rollout KL is 11% lower with half of the sampler's linear layers on the grid and 16% lower with all of them, and the synchronized weights we checked equal the learner's FP8 forward weights byte for byte. translated_title: Blackwell上的端到端MXFP8强化学习：匹配带来什么、何时划算以及如何失效
translated_abstract: 低精度算术可以降低大语言模型强化学习（RL）的成本，但RL要求采样器与学习器保持一致。目前已有若干框架在两侧都运行FP8。我们在verl中实现了端到端的MXFP8强化学习（训练采用Megatron/Transformer Engine；推理采样采用vLLM和SGLang；支持稠密模型和MoE模型），并在B200 GPU上使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B，测量了这种设计带来了什么收益、何时更快以及如何失败。（1）匹配。对于MXFP8学习器，使用学习器量化网格的采样器比更高精度的BF16采样器更一致：在固定权重的单一引擎中，当采样器一半的线性层置于该网格上时，训练-采样KL散度降低了11%，当全部线性层置于网格上时降低了16%，且我们检查的同步权重与学习器的FP8前向权重逐字节相同。在MoE模型上，采样器使用另一网格的FP8流水线从第一步起，其KL散度就是共享网格流水线的两倍。在没有量化……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文在Blackwell GPU上实现了verl框架中端到端的MXFP8强化学习，首次系统证明采样器与学习器使用相同的FP8量化网格比更高精度的BF16采样器更一致（显著降低训练-采样KL散度），并实证分析了这一设计何时带来加速以及何时会失效。
en_tdlr: This paper implements end-to-end MXFP8 reinforcement learning in verl on Blackwell GPUs, demonstrating that a sampler matching the learner's FP8 quantization grid is more consistent than a higher-precision BF16 sampler (reducing train-rollout KL by up to 16%), and systematically measuring when this design pays off in speed and how it fails.
